title: The Hebrew alef-bet: 22 letters with ancient pictographs, meanings and gematria
summary: A table of the whole Hebrew alphabet (alef-bet, final forms in brackets) in two columns, giving for each letter its modern form, name, English sound, ancient pictograph, picture meaning and gematria value, from alef = 1 (Strength, God) to tav = 400 (Covenant, Cross).

text.text: א ב ג ד ה ו ז ח ט י כ (ך) ל מ (ם) נ (ן) ס ע פ (ף) צ (ץ) ק ר ש ת

1. alef A — Strength, God — 1 · 2. bet B — Tent, House — 2 · 3. gimel G — Camel — 3 · 4. dalet D — Door — 4 · 5. he H — Revelation, Grace — 5 · 6. vav V,O,W,U — Hook, Nail — 6 · 7. zayin Z — Ax, Weapon — 7 · 8. chet Ch,H — Wall, Fence — 8 · 9. tet T — Coiled Snake — 9 · 10. yod I,J,Y — Hand, Work — 10 · 11. kaf K,Kh — Open Palm — 20 · 12. lamed L — Staff, Authority — 30 · 13. mem M — Water, Chaos — 40 · 14. nun N — Fish, Life — 50 · 15. samekh S — Support — 60 · 16. ayin A,O,E — Eye — 70 · 17. pe P — Mouth — 80 · 18. tsadi Tz — Trap, Hunt — 90 · 19. kuf Q — Sunrise, East — 100 · 20. resh R — Head — 200 · 21. shin Sh,S — Teeth, Destroy — 300 · 22. tav T — Covenant, Cross — 400

numbers.note: the table numbers the 22 letters of the alef-bet 1–22

pictures.description: Column of ancient (paleo-Hebrew) pictograph glyphs for letters 1–10 (alef through yod), each underlined in the letter's colour: ox head, tent, camel, door, figure with raised arms, hook, ax, wall, coiled snake, hand.
Column of ancient (paleo-Hebrew) pictograph glyphs for letters 11–22 (kaf through tav): open palm, staff, water waves, fish, support, eye, mouth, trap, sunrise, head, teeth, cross.

uncertain: Hebrew letter characters were read from the image; the Latin sound labels (e.g. “V,O,W,U”, “Ch,H”) transcribed as shown
